about: Akemehel, Samson's son by Delilah, demands the throne of the Philistines. One day, when the boys are drinking, the young king snatches the meat from his mouth, and Akemehel cuts off his head with a sword. The boy's mother Delilah rushes to kill him, but her sister Meksaba, the king's mother, disarms her, hides the death and sets him on the throne. The chapter ends by saying the Philistine kingdom, too, belongs to the seed of Shem.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ- + ከመ) introduces the story. ቀተሎ is ቀተለ 'killed' (3ms perfect) + -ሁ 'him' (assimilated to -ኦ). ወልደ is construct: ወልደ ሳምሶን 'son-of Samson'; ለወልደ ንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'the son of the king of the Philistines' has ለ- marking the object (a common Geʿez way to mark a definite object), with ንጉሠ the construct of ንጉሥ 'king'. The ፹፩ is the numeral 81. The 'son of Samson' is Delilah's boy (Menahem in ch. 80, called Akemehel here).

sentences.l: And-he-as-for son Akemehel son-of Samson, and-said-to-her to-his-mother Delilah: Why I not-reign and-not-sit upon this throne?
sentences.i: As for him, the boy Akemehel, the son of Samson, he said to his mother Delilah: 'Why do I not reign and sit on this throne?'
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'and as for him': ወ- 'and' + ውእቱ 'he' + enclitic -ሰ (topic or contrast). አከምሔል is the Geʿez form of the boy's name (spelled አኬሜሔል and ኣኬሜሔል later); ch. 80 called Delilah's son Menahem, so this is probably the same boy under another name (?). ወልድ is in apposition: 'the son Akemehel, son-of Samson' (ወልደ construct). ወይቤላ 'and he said to her' (ይቤ 3ms perfect of ይቤ 'say', + -ላ 'to her'), with the recipient repeated by ለእሙ 'to his mother' (ለ- + እም 'mother' + -ሁ 'his'). ለምንት 'why' (ለ- + ምንት 'what'). ኢይነግሥ and ወኢይነብር carry the 3ms prefix ይ- although አነ 'I' is the subject (the regular 1cs would be ኢእነግሥ); I read 'I do not reign / sit' (?), taking the 3ms prefix as a scribal or idiomatic slip for 1cs. Same pattern in ኢየኀድግ below. ላዕለ 'upon'; ዝንቱ 'this' (m.) with መንበር 'throne'.

sentences.i: His mother said to him: 'Leave it, my son. This throne was not your father's, and your father's country was not here.'

sentences.i: As for you, if the God of your fathers makes you great, you will go to your father's throne. But her son said to her: 'No! I will not leave you, my mother, or Meksaba, my mother, and I will reign here.'
sentences.n: ወአንተሰ 'and as for you' (the enclitic -ሰ again marks contrast). ለእመ 'if' (ለእመ + perfect, 'if he has made you great'). አልሀቀከ: ʾa-causative of ልህቀ 'grow', 'make great', 3ms perfect + -ከ 'you'. አምላከ አበዊከ 'God-of your-fathers' (construct; አበዊከ is the broken plural of አብ 'father' + -ከ). ተሐውር 2ms imperfect of ሖረ 'go'. ወይቤላ ወልዳ 'and her son said to her' (ወልዳ = ወልድ + -ሃ 'her'). አልቦ 'there is none', used here as an emphatic 'No'. Uncertain: ኢየኀድግ has the 3ms prefix ይ- ('he will not leave'); I take it as the boy speaking of himself and render 'I will not leave' (?); then ኪያኪ (2fs object pronoun 'you') and a second object 'Meksaba', each with እምየ 'my mother' (እም + -የ). The next verb ወእነግሥ is plainly 1cs 'and I will reign'. በዝየ 'here' (በ- + ዝየ). The unit ends at ፨, a stronger stop.

sentences.l: And-one day they-got-drunk both-of-them (m.), after passed lunch, and-were-shut the-doors.
sentences.i: One day the two of them got drunk (?), after the midday meal had passed and the doors had been shut.
sentences.n: ወአሐተ ዕለተ 'and one day' (አሐተ 'one' f. accusative, ዕለተ the accusative of ዕለት 'day', used adverbially). ሰክሩ 3mp perfect of ሰክረ 'be drunk'. Uncertain: ክልኤሆሙ is the masculine 'both of them' while the next unit says the two women were seated with the boys serving, so the drunk pair are probably the two boys; I give 'the two of them' to keep the ambiguity (?). እምድኅረ 'after' + perfect ኀለፈ 'passed'. ምሳሕ 'midday meal, lunch'. ተዐጽወ 3ms passive-reflexive perfect of ዐጸወ 'shut'; ኀዋኅው is the plural of ኆኅት 'door, gate'. The shut doors matter for the secrecy of what follows.

sentences.i: The two women were sitting to eat meat, while the boys played in front of them and ate with them, and one maidservant held a dish between them.
sentences.n: ወሀለዋ 'and they (f.) were' (ሀለወ 'be, exist', 3fp perfect; the ending is -ā). ይነብራ and ይብልዓ are 3fp forms (the ending -ā marks feminine plural): 'they sit', 'that they may eat' (ከመ + subjunctive). ክልኤሆን is the feminine 'both of them', so here the two women, Meksaba and Delilah. ወእሙንቱኒ ደቂቅ 'and those (m.) too, the boys' (እሙንቱ 'those' + -ኒ 'also'; ደቂቅ plural of ወልድ in the sense 'children'). ይትዋነዩ is the 3mp imperfect of ተዋነየ 'sport, play, make merry', as glossed in ch. 2–8 and ch. 80 (the same boys 'eat and play' there). ትእኅዝ 3fs imperfect of አኀዘ 'hold'. መጽብኅ 'dish, large platter' (a guess from context, ?) (spelled መጽብኀ in this unit, the object form, and መጽብኅ later). በማእከሌሆን 'between them' (በ- + ማእከል 'middle' + -ሆን f.).

sentences.n: ወነሥአ 'and he took' (ነሥአ 3ms perfect). Akemehel is called ወልደ ደሊላ 'son-of Delilah' (construct), to tell him from Meksaba's son. ምልአ ክልኤሆን እደዊሁ: ምልአ is the construct of ምልእ 'fullness', 'the fill of both his hands'; ክልኤሆን is the feminine 'both' because እድ 'hand' is a feminine noun (Geʿez has no true dual). እምነ መጽብኅ 'from the dish'. sentences.n: አውፅአ is the ʾa-causative of ወፅአ 'go out', so 'bring out, draw' (a sword); ሰይፎ 'his sword' (ሰይፍ + -ሁ). አውቀዮ: the root is not identified (?). The ending is 3ms perfect + -ሁ 'him' (written -ዮ after a final -y radical), so a double object 'him / his head' (ርእሶ = ርእስ + -ሁ); I take it as a verb of striking or cutting, 'cut off (?)', since the head then 'falls' (ወድቀት, 3fs perfect of ወድቀ; ርእስ is construed as feminine here). ውስተ 'into'. The last clause is obscure (?): ዘእንበለ 'without, before' + imperfect የኀጥ. The draft read this as 'swallows' (ውኅጠ), but the form fits ይኀጥእ 'errs, misses' (ኀጥአ, with the final ʾ unwritten; compare ወየኀጥኡ 'and they err' in ch. 35 and ኢተኀጥአ in ch. 24, 36), so 'without missing (the dish)' (?). እንተ ሄደ 'which went' (ሄደ the Amharic-type 'went' for ሖረ, as in ch. 43 and 73–75; the feminine እንተ would refer to the head) remains unclear (?). Unresolved. The unit ends at ፤.

(an አስተ- stem, no object suffix); with ዲበ ክሳዲ 'upon the neck' I take it as 'she pressed it close, held it up against' her neck (?). ክሳዲ is read 'her neck' by inference: the ending is unexplained, as in ክሳዲኒ in ch. 33–34 (?). ከደነቶ 'she covered it' (ከደነ 'cover' + -ሁ), with ልብሳ 'her garment' (ልብስ + -ሃ).

sentences.n: ወተንሥአት ደሊላ 'and Delilah rose'. መልኀት 'she drew out' (መልኀ 'draw, pull out', as of a sword; lexical call made without Dillmann, ?); ሰይፈ ምውት 'the sword-of the-dead (one)' (construct, ሰይፈ), with ምውት 'dead' used as a noun, then ወልደ እኅታ 'son-of her sister' in apposition: the dead king is Meksaba's son, Delilah's nephew. ሖረት 'she went'. ከመ ትቅትሎ 'that she might kill him' (ከመ + 3fs subjunctive + -ሎ), and the object is repeated as ለኣኬሜሔል 'namely Akemehel' (ለ- marks the object). sentences.n: ተጸወነ is the tä-stem of ጸወነ ('take, protect'), so 'took cover, hid himself' (?). ምስዋረ ዐምድ: ምስዋር is the noun of place from ሰወረ 'hide', 'hiding place' (as glossed in ch. 46–48, ?) sentences.n: እኅታ 'her sister' is Meksaba; ወአኀዘታ 'and she seized her' (አኀዘ + -ታ). እንዘ ትብል 'saying' (እንዘ + 3fs imperfect of ይቤ: 'while she says'). ተሀጐልነ: tä-stem of ሀጐለ 'perish, be lost', here the 1cp perfect (-ነ 'we'): 'we were lost, have been lost', not a future. sentences.i: 'As for this one, he is of an evil stock and cannot bear good fruit. Come, my sister. He will not destroy you either.' And she took the sword from her hand, and brought out of her store (?) a fine garment of purple (?), which kings wear, and gave it to him, and soothed him (?) with sweet words, saying: 'Take the garment, my son, and sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Philistines.' But he became grim (?), like a bear, for he wanted to kill them both until they had left the house, and they went out;
sentences.n: This unit runs to about 49 words, a little over the usual limit, but has no ፤ inside it, so it is not cut. The speech of Meksaba continues: ዘጒንዲ እኩይ 'of evil trunk (stock)' (ጒንዲ 'stump, trunk'), the image of a bad tree that cannot ፈሪየ ሠናየ 'bear good fruit' (infinitive ፈሪ + accusative ሠናየ). ኒዒ is read as ንዒ, the feminine imperative 'come!' (?). ኢያህጒልኪ 'he will not destroy you' (ʾa-causative አህጐለ of ሀጐለ + -ኪ 2fs). Then ወነሥአት 'and she took' (Meksaba takes Delilah's sword) እምእዴሃ 'from her hand'. አንሥአት 'she lifted/brought out'. Uncertain: ትርኣስ 'store' (?; a guess from context, the word is unidentified; a link with ርእስ 'head' is conceivable), ሜላት (a dyed stuff, perhaps purple, as in ch. 17–20 and 43; ?), ወየውሀቶ 'and soothed him' (?; perhaps a verb from የዋህ 'gentle', 3fs perfect + -ሁ, with no root I can confirm), ፀዋገ 'grim, sullen' (?), the accusative predicate of ኮነ (the house glosses differ: 'wretched, base' in ch. 2–8 and 76, 'captor' in ch. 49–50, so this is one more guess), the comparison ከመ ድብ 'like a bear' being sure. ዘይለብሱ 'which they wear' (ዘ- + 3mp of ለብሰ). ንሣእ is the imperative 'take!'; ወትነብር 'and you shall sit' (2ms). ይቅትሎን 'he kill them (f.)'; የኀድጋ 'they (f.) leave' (3fp, ending -ā). Source quirk: ለክል ፡ ኤሆን is a single word (ክልኤሆን 'both of them') split by a wordspace.

The point seems to be that the Philistine crown, held by Samson's son (of Dan, a descendant of Shem; cf. Genesis 10:21), stays in Shem's line, although Genesis 10:14 lists the Philistines under Ham. glossary.ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
glossary.ለእሙ: እም — to his mother (ለ- + noun 'mother' + -ሁ '3ms his', giving እሙ)
glossary.ለክል: ክልኤቱ — to both (ለ- + ክል-, first part of ክልኤሆን split by a wordspace in the source)
glossary.ለወልደ: ወልድ — the son of (ለ- marking the object + noun, construct) · to the son of (ለ- 'to', dative, parallel to ለንጉሥ: ሀቦ ... ለወልደ ንጉሥ 'give ... to the king's son')
glossary.ለዘርአ: ዘርእ — to the seed of (ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
glossary.ሐመ: ሐመ — he was ill (3ms perfect, G, ḥ-m-m)
glossary.መሐዛት: መሐዛት — unidentified plural noun, subject of ወወውዑ (lemma not recovered) (?) · here the subject of ወተስእልዎ, 'attendants (?)' (ወተስእልዎ መሐዛት 'and the attendants (?) asked him'); no ወወውዑ in this chapter; lemma still unrecovered (?)
glossary.መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
glossary.መክሳባ: መክሳባ — Meksaba (proper name; the Philistine queen in this tradition)
glossary.መጽብኀ: መጽብኅ — dish, platter (noun, accusative; variant spelling of መጽብኅ)
glossary.ሜላተ: ሜላተ — obscure word for something spread or laid (accusative; maybe a covering) (?) · here accusative of ሜላት, 'the purple (?) garment' (ለብሰ ሜላተ 'put on the garment of ሜላት'); ch. 17–20, 43 'a dyed stuff' (?)
glossary.ምልአ: ምልእ — fill, fullness (noun, construct 'fill-of'; ምልአ እደዊሁ 'the fill of his hands')
glossary.ምስዋረ: ምስዋር — hiding place (noun of place from ሰወረ 'hide', construct 'hiding-place of') (?)
glossary.ምውት: ምውት — dead, dead one (adjective, used as a noun)
glossary.ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
glossary.ሥጋ: ሥጋ — flesh, body (noun; construct 'flesh of') · 'meat' as food (ከመ ይብልዓ ሥጋ 'to eat meat'; ነሥአ ሥጋ 'took meat') · his body, with -ሁ (ሥጋሁ)
glossary.ሰክሩ: ሰክረ — they got drunk (3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ቀተሎ: ቀተለ — he killed him (3m sg perfect + -o, q-t-l)
glossary.ቅድሜሆን: ቅድሜ — before them (f.) (preposition/noun 'front, before' + -ሆን '3fp them', ቅድሜ-; lemma form as in the house glossaries)
glossary.በማእከሌሆን: ማእከል — between them (f.) (በ- 'in' + noun 'middle' + -ሆን '3fp them', ማእከሌ-)
glossary.በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house (noun, construct state 'house-of') · accusative 'the house' as object of a verb (የኀድጋ ቤተ 'they leave the house')
glossary.ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
glossary.ቦኣ: ቦአ — they (f.) entered (3fp perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ተሀጐልነ: ተሀጐለ — we were lost, have been lost (1cp perfect, tä-stem of ሀጐለ 'perish'; -ነ '1cp we'; not a future)
glossary.ተሐውር: ሖረ — she goes (3fs imperfect, G) · 2ms 'you go, you will go' (ተሐውር ኀበ መንበረ አቡከ 'you will go to your father's throne')
glossary.ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
glossary.ተጸወነ: ተጸወነ — he took cover, hid himself (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ጸወነ 'protect') (?)
glossary.ትቅትሎ: ቀተለ — that she kill him (3fs subjunctive, G, q-t-l + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
glossary.ትእኅዝ: አኀዘ — she holds (3fs imperfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z)
glossary.ኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — he/it passed away (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀሠሥዎ: ኀሠሠ — they sought him (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-ś-ś + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀዋኅው: ኆኅት — doors, gates (noun, plural of ኆኅት 'door')
glossary.ኅድግ: ኀደገ — leave! (2ms imperative, G, ḫ-d-g; Bezold's spelling ኅድግ)
glossary.ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
glossary.ኒዒ: ንዓ — come! (imperative 2fs, written ኒዒ for ንዒ; ms ንዓ, pl ንዑ)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልሀቀከ: አልሀቀ — he made you great (3ms perfect, causative of ልህቀ 'grow' + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አኀዞን: አኀዘ — it seized them (f.) (3ms perfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z + -ዖን '3fp them'; 3ms before two nouns)
glossary.አከምሔል: አከምሔል — Akemehel (proper name; Samson's son by Delilah; also spelled ኣኬሜሔል, አኬሜሔል)
glossary.አኬሜሔል: አከምሔል — Akemehel (proper name; spelling of አከምሔል)
glossary.አፉሆን: አፍ — their (f.) mouths (noun + -ሆን '3fp their', form አፉ-)
glossary.ኢኮነት: ኮነ — she was not (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ኢየኀድግ: ኀደገ — he does not leave (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g); with the speaker's own 'I' as sense, 'I will not leave' (?)
glossary.ኢያህጒልኪ: አህጐለ — he will not destroy you (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ሀጐለ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ኢያእመራ: አእመረ — they (f.) did not know (ኢ- 'not' + 3fp imperfect of አእመረ 'know', ʾa-stem; rendered past)
glossary.ኢይነግሥ: ነግሠ — he does not reign (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, n-g-š); with subject አነ 'I' the person is irregular, read 'I do not reign' (?)
glossary.ኢይክል: ከህለ — none can (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-h-l) · 'he cannot' (ኢይክል ፈሪየ ሠናየ 'he cannot bear good fruit')
glossary.ኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (f.) (-ኤሆን, second part of ክልኤሆን split by a wordspace: -ሆን '3fp')
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እማቲሆሙ: አመት — their maidservants (?) (plural አእማት + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written without the initial አ; አመት 'maidservant') (?) · 'their mothers' (plural እማት of እም 'mother' + -ሆሙ; እማንቱሰ እማቲሆሙ 'as for the boys' mothers') (?)
glossary.እምትርኣሲሃ: ትርኣስ — from her store (?) (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሃ '3fs her'; lemma and sense uncertain, from context) (?)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምአፉሁ: አፍ — from his mouth (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form አፉ-)
glossary.እምእዴሃ: እድ — from her hand (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሃ '3fs her', form እዴ-)
glossary.እምካልኣኒሆሙ: ካልእ — from their others, their companions (እም- 'from' + plural ካልኣን 'others' + -ሆሙ '3mp their') (?)
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed')
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እዴሁ: እድ — his hand (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; with suffix እዴ-)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ክልኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (feminine; numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp', of the hands) · of the two women, 'both of them' (ይነብራ ክልኤሆን 'both sit')
glossary.ክረምት: ክረምት — winter, rainy season; year (noun; counted here as a feminine, ፭ ክረምት spoken ኀምስ, gender unchecked (?))
glossary.ክሳዲ: ክሳድ — neck (noun; the final -ዲ is unexplained, as in ክሳዲኒ ch. 33–34; 'her neck' by inference) (?)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
glossary.ወሀለዋ: ሀለወ — and they (f.) were (ወ- + 3fp perfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ወለብሰ: ለብሰ — and he put on, wore (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, l-b-s)
glossary.ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወመልኀት: መልኀ — and she drew out (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, m-l-ḫ) (?)
glossary.ወመገብት: መጋቢ — and stewards (?) (ወ- + noun, plural; house reading 'stewards' ch. 29, 38–39, 43; the plural form is not as expected) (?)
glossary.ወሠርዑ: ሠርዐ — and they laid down, established (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወሥጋሁኒ: ሥጋ — and his body also (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወቀበራሁ: ቀበረ — and they (f.) buried him (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, q-b-r + -ሁ '3ms him')
glossary.ወተስእልዎ: ተስእለ — and they asked (him) (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ተስእለ, tä-stem of ሰአለ, is the usual 'ask, inquire'; 'asked about him' (?)) (?)
glossary.ወተናጸራ: ተናጸረ — and they (f.) looked at one another (ወ- + 3fp perfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ነጸረ, n-ṣ-r)
glossary.ወተንሥአት: ተንሥአ — and she arose (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተዐጽወ: ዐጸወ — and it was shut (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive, ʿ-ṣ-w; 3ms before a plural subject)
glossary.ወተደለወ: ተደለወ — and he made himself ready (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ደለወ 'be ready, prepare')
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተፈጸመ: ተፈጸመ — and he/it was finished, completed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ፈጸመ); said of death
glossary.ወተፍእመ: ተፍእመ — and he crammed (his mouth) (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect; lemma not recovered, sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወትነብር: ነበረ — and she sits, dwells (ወ- + 3fs imperfect) · also 2ms 'and you will dwell' (ወትነብር ውስተ ብሔርነ)
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነሥአት: ነሥአ — and she took (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነሥእዎ: ነሥአ — and they took him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአሐተ: አሐቲ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem., accusative አሐተ)
glossary.ወአሐቲ: አሐዱ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
glossary.ወአስተጣግዐት: አስተጣግዐ — and she pressed close (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, astä-stem; lemma not recovered, sense from context with ዲበ ክሳዲ) (?)
glossary.ወአኀዘታ: አኀዘ — and she seized her (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ሃ '3fs her', joined as ታ)
glossary.ወአንሥአት: አንሥአ — and she lifted (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative of the root ነሥአ)
glossary.ወአንቀጥቀጠ: አንቀጥቀጠ — and he shook, set (his hand and foot) trembling (ወ- + 3ms perfect, quadriliteral, አን- on ቀጥቀጠ)
glossary.ወአንበርዎ: አንበረ — and they made him settle (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነበረ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአውቀዮ: አውቀየ — and he struck him (?), cut off (his head) (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ዮ '3ms him', after a final -y radical; double object with ርእሶ; lemma and root uncertain, sense from context) (?)
glossary.ወአውፅአ: አውፅአ — and he brought out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወፅአ)
glossary.ወኢለመኑሂ: መኑ — and not to anyone (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + ለ- 'to' + 'who' + -ሂ 'even, any')
glossary.ወኢረከብዎ: ረከበ — and they did not find him (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, r-k-b + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወኢነገራ: ነገረ — and they (f.) did not tell (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3fp perfect, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወኢይነብር: ነበረ — and he does not sit, dwell (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r); with subject አነ 'I' the person is irregular, read 'and I do not sit' (?)
glossary.ወእማንቱሰ: እማንቱ — and as for those (f.) (ወ- + 3fp demonstrative/pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and from then, from that time (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb 'then')
glossary.ወእነግሥ: ነግሠ — and I will reign (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G, n-g-š)
glossary.ወእገሪሁ: እግር — and his foot (feet) (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form እገሪ-; singular used collectively, so l 'foot', i 'feet')
glossary.ወከደነቶ: ከደነ — and she covered him/it (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, k-d-n + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወወድቀት: ወድቀ — and it fell (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-d-q)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወወፅኣ: ወፅአ — and they (f.) went out (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውኅጣ: ውኅጠ — and they (f.) swallowed (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, w-ḫ-ṭ)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘአትረፈ: አትረፈ — and that which he left over (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, causative of ተርፈ 'remain', t-r-f)
glossary.ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወየውሀቶ: የውሀ — and she soothed him (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ; perhaps denominative of የዋህ 'gentle'; lemma uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወይበልዑ: በልዐ — and they eat (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይእቲሰ: ይእቲ — and she, as for her (ወ- + fem. pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወድንጋፄ: ድንጋፄ — and dismay, terror (ወ- + noun; also spelled ድንጋጼ)
glossary.ወገነዛ: ገነዘ — and they (f.) wrapped a corpse (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, g-n-z)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘሜላት: ሜላት — unknown word (ዘ- + noun), perhaps a material or craft term; meaning from context (?) · 'of purple (?)', a dyed stuff as in ch. 17–20, 43 (ልብሰ ሠናየ ዘሜላት 'a fine garment of purple (?)') (?)
glossary.ዘተወልደ: ተወልደ — who was born (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive/reflexive stem of ወለደ)
glossary.ዘተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — who transgressed, departed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ)
glossary.ዘአቡከ: አብ — of your father (ዘ- 'of' + noun + -ከ '2ms your', form አቡ-)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘይለብሱ: ለብሰ — which they wear (ዘ- 'which' + 3mp imperfect, G, l-b-s)
glossary.ዘይገብራ: ገብረ — what they (f.) should do (ዘ- 'what' + 3fp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘጒንዲ: ጒንድ — of the trunk, stock (ዘ- 'of' + noun 'trunk, stock'; Bezold's spelling ጒንዲ, as in the house glossaries)
glossary.የኀድጋ: ኀደገ — they (f.) leave, have left (3fp subjunctive, G, ḫ-d-g; እስከ የኀድጋ 'until they leave'; ሶበ የኀድጋ 'when they had left')
glossary.የኀጥ: ኀጥአ — he misses, errs (3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-ṭ-ʾ; የ- the guttural-initial prefix, ይኀጥእ with the final ʾ unwritten; ዘእንበለ የኀጥ 'without missing'; cf. ወየኀጥኡ ch. 35) (?)
glossary.ይቅትሎን: ቀተለ — that he kill them (f.) (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l + -ሆን '3fp them')
glossary.ይብልዓ: በልዐ — that they (f.) may eat (3fp subjunctive, G, b-l-ʿ)
glossary.ይትዋነዩ: ተዋነየ — they play, sport (3mp imperfect, tä-stem, w-n-y; house gloss 'sport, play' ch. 2–8, 80)
glossary.ይነብራ: ነበረ — they (f.) sit, remain (3fp imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ጠለፎ: ጠለፈ — he snatched it (3ms perfect, G, ṭ-l-f + -ሁ '3ms him/it')
glossary.ጥብሬሌስ: ጥብሬሌስ — Tibreles (proper name; the young Philistine king) (?)
glossary.ጸፍጸፈ: ጸፍጸፍ — floor, pavement (noun, construct 'floor-of'; ጸፍጸፈ ቤት 'floor of the house') (?)
glossary.ፀዋገ: ፀዋግ — captor, one who takes captive (noun; accusative; lexical call from context) (?) · 'grim (?)' here, predicate of ኮነ before ከመ ድብ 'like a bear' (ወውእቱሰ ኮነ ፀዋገ 'and he became grim (?)'; one more guess) (?)
glossary.ፈሪየ: ፈሪ — fruit; to bear fruit (noun ፈሪ, accusative, or the verbal noun of ፈርየ; l reads 'to-bear-fruit', i 'bear good fruit') (?)
glossary.ፈርሃ: ፈርሀ — they (f.) feared (3fp perfect, G, f-r-h; ending -ā)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
glossary.፹፩: ፹፩ — 81, spoken ሰማንያ ወአሐዱ (sämanəya wä-ʾaḥadu) 'eighty-one'; chapter number (numeral)
